title: Dev version strings must be bumped together across Python, UI, docs, Java, R and build files; Helm appVersion tracks the last release
answers: after a release, why does the version differ between mlflow, the UI, docs and Java/R?
CI uv sync --locked fails after bumping the dev version in pyproject.toml
how do I bump MLflow to the next dev version after a release tag?
why is charts/Chart.yaml appVersion not the new dev version?
body:
Symptom: After a release, the installed mlflow package, the web UI, the docs and the Java/R artifacts report different version numbers, or the next dev cycle is only partly bumped. A bumped pyproject.toml with a stale uv.lock mlflow entry can fail the CI `uv sync --locked` step.
Root cause: The version is duplicated in mlflow/version.py:VERSION, pyproject.toml and pyproject.release.toml ([project] version), libs/skinny/pyproject.toml, libs/tracing/pyproject.toml, mlflow/server/js/src/common/constants.tsx:Version, docs/src/constants.ts:Version, mlflow/java/pom.xml, mlflow/R/mlflow/DESCRIPTION and charts/Chart.yaml.
Fix pattern: Bump all of these in one change to the next dev version (X.Y.Z.dev0 for Python/UI/docs, X.Y.Z-SNAPSHOT for Java, X.Y.Z for R). Only the editable mlflow package entry in uv.lock is updated, not the whole lockfile.
Constraints: Helm charts/Chart.yaml appVersion is set to the just-released version, not the new dev version. The pyproject.release.toml mlflow-skinny/mlflow-tracing pins must point at the same new dev version. Do not hand-edit generated lockfile churn beyond the mlflow entry. A reviewer on the version-bump PR reported that the uv.lock mlflow entry must be regenerated in the same change as pyproject.toml, because `uv sync --locked` rejects a stale entry; the PR description had excluded uv.lock, so treat this as reviewer-reported rather than settled.
Applies: Release-time version bumps in this repository after a release tag is cut. Not for changes to dependency bounds (see the version-bounds note).

search: Post-release dev version bumps require synchronizing version strings across Python, UI, docs, Java, R, and build configurations in a single change to prevent version mismatches and CI uv sync --locked failures. Updates must bump mlflow/version.py:VERSION, pyproject.toml, pyproject.release.toml, libs/skinny/pyproject.toml, libs/tracing/pyproject.toml, mlflow/server/js/src/common/constants.tsx:Version, docs/src/constants.ts:Version, mlflow/java/pom.xml, and mlflow/R/mlflow/DESCRIPTION to their respective dev version formats, while updating only the editable mlflow entry in uv.lock. As an exception, Helm charts/Chart.yaml appVersion tracks the just-released version instead of the new dev version, and pyproject.release.toml pins for mlflow-skinny and mlflow-tracing must target the new dev version. This guidance applies to release-time version bumps after cutting a release tag, excluding dependency bounds modifications, and warns against hand-editing lockfile churn beyond the mlflow entry.
